vacancy.title: Thermal/Cryogenics Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESA/ESTEC Thermal Control Section role, A2-A4 (potential A1 for fewer than four years post-MSc relevant experience), four-year appointment extendable indefinitely. Excellent overlap with MSc lunar rover thermal-switch thesis, thermal modelling, hardware prototyping and verification. Significant stretch: mandatory cryogenics experience, spacecraft thermal engineering and ESATAN-TMS familiarity; minimum four years relevant professional experience.
